name: v27-d-06-presence
objective: v2.7 06 live (D) row, no model. Two group chats in two stories (a saga with chapters, an act whose story display sets chapter_card false): the plays index (extensionSettings plays) holds a row per chat with the right story and kind; the saga chat shows the opening chapter card ('Arrival') after its first boundary and the act chat shows none (per-story off, while its story has chapters); the settings Continue list (#so-continue-list) lists both, the newer (act) first, each with its kind; the group's list entry carries one .so-story-badge naming the most recently played story, and no solo character entry carries a badge; the wand menu holds the Story entries and 'Open the story drawer' opens the drawer; the Help panel moved with the arrow keys keeps its position across a reload (panels.help). Cleanup restores the panels key and drops the plays rows of the run's chats. Not expressed: paging a 10-per-page list across two pages (the toy install has too few groups; charListBadges.test.ts pages a fake list), library delete keeps a pinned row (presenceIndex.test.ts F14), the payload-invariance capture with every item on and off. Run twice: node scripts/debug/so-scenario.mts run test/scenarios/v27-d-06-presence.json --sandbox --group "Group: Arin, DM Narrator" (a no-model lane: st-lanes.mts no-model <n>).

requires.why: scripted messages only; a model would only add reads the presence surfaces do not depend on
